protocol.forced_index: SET LOCAL enable_seqscan = off so the HNSW index is used at every ef

claim_boundary: Chunk-level index recall on 2,039 vectors with one query set; not a general HNSW benchmark. recall@50 below 1.0 at ef<50 is truncation (HNSW returns at most ef rows), not approximation error. natural_scan records that the planner reverts to an exact seq scan above ef=40 on this corpus; recall here is measured with the index forced on.
